title: Microsoft Viva: SharePoint agent analytics in Viva Insights
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and Agent Dashboard controls are supported, and it distinguishes the planned SharePoint analytics from the existing dashboard. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft licensing documentation and cite the additional licensing and PowerShell references.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page requires at least 50 assigned Microsoft Copilot licences for the Copilot Agent Dashboard view.
claims.quote: Copilot Agent Dashboard: Your organization must have at least 50 Microsoft Copilot licenses assigned and have agent activity.
claims.fix: Add to the Licence paragraph: 'Microsoft documentation differs: the Copilot Dashboard licensing table also lists Agent Dashboard as included with at least 50 Viva Insights licences, whereas the Agent Dashboard page requires at least 50 Microsoft Copilot licences.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/org-team-insights/copilot-dashboard#feature-availability-based-on-licenses and add it to sources. Keep these as dashboard requirements, not confirmed requirements for this roadmap item.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard view also requires agent activity.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Agent 365 Dashboard view requires the Copilot Agent Dashboard requirements plus Agent 365 licensing.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard: The same licensing requirements as the Copilot Agent Dashboard view, plus Agent 365 licensing.

claims.claim: The All agents toggle does not appear when the Agent 365 Dashboard licensing requirement is unmet.
claims.quote: If your organization doesn't meet this requirement, the All agents toggle won't appear in the dashboard.

claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard reports Copilot Credit usage associated with employees without Microsoft Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Provides leaders and analysts with actionable insights into agent adoption and associated Copilot Credit usage, which measures how agents are used by employees who don't have Microsoft Copilot licenses.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page does not describe the dashboard itself as generating charges.
claims.quote: Searched: price, meter, charge and Copilot Credit in the fetched learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/org-team-insights/agent-dashboard text. Read its licensing section and credit-reporting passages; they describe eligibility and reported agent consumption, not a dashboard charge.

claims.claim: The settings page specifies AI Administrator for managing Agent Dashboard and Viva Insights web app access.
claims.quote: Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups ... Applies to: AI Administrator ... Enable or disable the Agent Dashboard ... Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can also manage all these settings.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: The minimum group size section applies to AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator.
claims.quote: Set minimum group size for the Copilot Dashboard and Agent Dashboard ... Applies to: AI Administrator and Viva Insights Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra ID is the default source of Agent Dashboard organisational data.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard can get organizational data in one of three ways: Through Microsoft Entra ID, which is the default setting

claims.claim: Uploading an organisational data file is an alternative to the default Entra ID source, not a universal prerequisite.
claims.quote: Through Microsoft Entra ID, which is the default setting; Through an organizational data file in Microsoft 365 that your Global admin uploads; Through an organizational data file that your Insights admin uploads

claims.claim: Agent Dashboard availability is managed in Microsoft 365 admin center at Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Access Management > Turn Advanced Insights on or off > Feature access management > Agent Dashboard > Add policy.
claims.quote: Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. On the Feature access management page, select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> ... [-Everyone] ... $false: The feature is not enabled by the policy.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchange/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy to sources for the cmdlet syntax. The existing settings page supplies ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId AgentDashboard and the tenant-wide disable values; keep the call unchanged.

claims.claim: Individual web app access can be granted in Microsoft 365 admin center at Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. Search for the people you'd like to add, and select them from the list. At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: The Everyone switch specifies that the policy applies to all users in the organization. ... The IsFeatureEnabled parameter specifies whether or not the feature is enabled by the policy.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchange/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy to sources for the cmdlet syntax. The existing settings page supplies ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId Viva Insights web app and the tenant-wide disable values; keep the call unchanged.

claims.claim: For tenants without Viva Insights licensing, minimum group size is managed at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Microsoft Viva > Microsoft Viva Insights > Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365 > Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote: If your tenant does not have a Viva Insights license ... go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights. Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: An API or PowerShell operation for setting this minimum group size is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights minimum group size PowerShell API Set minimum group size Agent Dashboard; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Viva Insights minimum group size privacy settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/graph Viva Insights minimum group size settings update. Read settings and privacy-settings.

claims.claim: Both the Agent Dashboard control and the Viva Insights web app control must be enabled to access Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.claim: Turning off the Viva Insights web app control disables the entire app, including the Copilot Dashboard and Copilot Analytics reports.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard and web app feature access policies can apply at tenant, group or user level.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level ... The AI admin can turn the Viva Insights web app on or off at the tenant, group, or user level

claims.claim: In tenants with Viva Insights licensing, a Viva Insights Administrator changes the minimum group size in Viva Insights privacy settings.
claims.quote: Or, if your tenant has a Viva Insights license and you're a Viva Insights Administrator, use these steps to change the minimum group size.

claims.claim: The unified exclusion list is managed with Viva Feature Access Management.
claims.quote: You can manage the exclusion list with Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) using PowerShell or VFAM.

claims.claim: The exclusion policy must be turned on for an exclusion list to apply.
claims.quote: To use an exclusion list, you must turn on the policy.
